predictions.rationale: The change request mentions issues with the internal XSLTProcess in Ivy. Ivy.java is the main class of Ivy and is likely to be affected by such issues.
IvyReport.java is related to reporting and might be impacted if the XSLTProcess is not initialized properly.
XmlReportOutputter.java handles XML reports and might be affected if the XSLTProcess is not initialized.
ResolveReport.java is related to resolving dependencies and might be impacted if the XSLTProcess is not initialized.
ConfigurationResolveReport.java is related to resolving configurations and might be impacted if the XSLTProcess is not initialized.
ModuleDescriptor.java is related to module descriptors and might be impacted if the XSLTProcess is not initialized.
DependencyArtifactDescriptor.java is related to dependency artifacts and might be impacted if the XSLTProcess is not initialized.
Artifact.java is related to artifacts and might be impacted if the XSLTProcess is not initialized.
ArtifactId.java is related to artifact IDs and might be impacted if the XSLTProcess is not initialized.
ArtifactRevisionId.java is related to artifact revisions and might be impacted if the XSLTProcess is not initialized.

limitations: A single model call is one sample; repeated calls can differ in lower ranks.
Changed-path labels are not a complete oracle for every file potentially affected.
Issue cleaning decisions are recorded in the task manifest.
C0_CONSTRAINED is a candidate-list prompt condition, not a hard decoding constraint; invalid paths are still rejected.
